items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms the name 'Damon Hayes' when prompted by the interviewer but does not describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with him, only mentioning him in the context of a band lineup.

ctx.x: Yeah. Harlan was in the band but he wasn't -- he didn't have it to run his band at the first time -- you know.

Yeah, Damon Hayes (PHONETIC). And so we -- I was -- and I left the band and come back to Cincinnati, and stayed with them -- well Chris had a guy to get the band together. His name was Clarence Page (PHONETIC). So I played with Clarence Page. He just died incidentally about two months ago now.
